sentences.text: 1  Court No. - 83  HON'BLE SHEKHAR KUMAR YADAV, J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State as also perused the record.

2. This application under Section 529 BNSS has been filed seeking direction to the court below for expeditious disposal of Case No.154 of 2022 arising out of Case Crime No.283 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kotwali Orai, District Jalaun pending before Civil Judge, Judicial Magistrate/FTC (Offence against Women), Jalaun at Orai within a shortest span of time as fixed by this Court.

entities.text: Police Station Kotwali Orai, District Jalaun
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Civil Judge, Judicial Magistrate/FTC (Offence against Women), Jalaun at Orai
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court concerned to decide the aforesaid case as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.
(Shekhar Kumar Yadav,J.) September 3, 2025 Ajeet  Smt Preeti vs State Of U.P. And Another on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169439620/
